title: Wendigo Origin
description: A one origin data pack that turns you into a flesh eating monster
body: this origin is suited for pvp, with phasing to ambush through walls, a hunt mode to close the distance, and an inescapable hunger to match the fury you can bring. but such power comes at a price. you are vulnerable to fire, which disables your hunt mode, and rain disables your phasing abilities, and having the abilities active rapidly drains your hunger.
